text:
Luca (Prod Marketing): Hey team — need a compact, brand-safe "metric canvas" for next week's webinar. Objective: one hero benchmark graphic + 3 slide templates showing latency vs cost, routing diagram for inbound leads, and two social tile variants. Deliverables by Wed EOD (Mar 31).
Jamie (Creative Ops): Got it. Can you share the exact metrics and the webinar title?
Luca (Prod Marketing): Title: 'Serving Wins: Inference Economics in Production'. Metrics: p50 latency @ typical seq length, tokens/sec, cost per 1k tokens (hosted vs dedicated), and % reduction with caching. Don't invent numbers — use the eval sheet link.
Anya (Growth): Also please include a clear CTA block for 'Register' vs 'Request a demo' with routing notes for HubSpot. We want a small 2-step decision map.
Sam (Design): Re: format — SVG hero + editable Figma slide kit, 1200x630 social tile + 1080x1080. Do we need language variants?
Luca (Prod Marketing): EN only for initial launch. Add space for localized copy later. Keep layout modular.
Jamie (Creative Ops): Noted. For the routing diagram, do you want an arrow flow or swimlanes?
Anya (Growth): Arrow flow is fine but label the routing: webinar reg -> nurture email -> demo SDR queue (priority if >X score). We'll add the numeric thresholds later.
Sam (Design): Creating a quick scaffold in Figma. Sharing file.
FigmaBot: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/metric-canvas-webinar-kit — comment access enabled.
Sam (Design): Pasting quick copy options for hero CTA: 1) 'See how inference economics scale' 2) 'Cut inference costs without sacrificing latency' 3) 'Join the webinar: real production benchmarks' — which one?
Luca (Prod Marketing): Lean into #2. Shorten to: 'Cut inference costs — keep latency tight'.
Jamie (Creative Ops): Checklist for deliverables:
- Hero benchmark graphic (SVG + PNG 2x)
- 3 slide templates (title + one data slide + routing diag)
- Social tile x2 sizes + short copy variants
- Figma kit with tokens & componentized legend
- Brand compliance checklist for Legal
Jamie (Creative Ops): Timeline proposal: initial mockups by Mon EOD, review Tues, final assets Wed EOD. OK?
Luca (Prod Marketing): Works for me. We only have a short review window with product.
LegalBot: Heads up — any claim with percentages or 'cost reduction' needs a source line in small type. If using internal evals, tag the eval doc and add a footnote.
Sam (Design): Will add a muted footnote area. Also planning two color treatments: brand-primary and a high-contrast variant for accessibility.
Anya (Growth): For HubSpot routing: please add a plain-text label for the hidden form field 'campaign_source' and the webinar slug so Ops can map it.
Jamie (Creative Ops): Copying the growth ops snippet into the figma notes:
```
campaign_source=serving-wins
webinar_slug=serving-wins-mar31
```
Jamie (Creative Ops): Any hard legal no-nos on imagery? We plan to use a simple stylized rack + latency sparkline.
LegalBot: Avoid using competitor logos or implying direct comparisons unless sourced. Stylized infra imagery is fine.
Luca (Prod Marketing): Great. Also need a micro-variant for LinkedIn Stories (vertical). Sam, can you include that in the Figma file?
Sam (Design): Yep. Adding 1080x1920 variant.
Jamie (Creative Ops): Action items: Sam — mockups by Mon EOD. Jamie — build review thread + create Asana task for localization later. Anya — confirm HubSpot mapping and thresholds. Luca — prepare eval links and final copy.
Anya (Growth): I'll post the HubSpot mapping here by Tue AM.
Luca (Prod Marketing): Sharing eval sheet: https://docs.internal/redwood/evals/serving-wins (internal) — use only cited figures.
Sam (Design): Quick question — do we want an animation for the hero (simple sparkline draw)? Should I prototype?
Luca (Prod Marketing): Nice to have but not required for launch. Ship static first; animate if time.
Jamie (Creative Ops): I'll schedule the review at 10am Tue. Tagging product for a quick look.
Sam (Design): Cool — starting now. Will ping when mockups live in Figma. :rocket:
Luca (Prod Marketing): Thanks team!
Jamie (Creative Ops): :thumbsup:
